ihealth-track-kn-550bt.question: Is the iHealth Track KN-550BT FDA cleared?
ihealth-track-kn-550bt.answer: FDA K160014 identifies the Wireless Blood Pressure Monitor, model KN-550BT, and records a substantially equivalent decision dated July 13, 2016. FDA clearance is not FDA approval, endorsement, independent validation, or proof of superior accuracy.

ihealth-track-kn-550bt.question: What cuff sizes does the reviewed manufacturer offer document?
ihealth-track-kn-550bt.answer: The current manufacturer offer separates standard SKU 550BT with a 22–42 cm cuff from SKU 550BT-XL with a 42–48 cm cuff. No public official crosswalk was found mapping each of the three primary device identifiers to the standard versus XL retail package.

ihealth-track-kn-550bt.question: What did the exact-model validation study report?
ihealth-track-kn-550bt.answer: A 2024 peer-reviewed paper names the exact KN-550BT model. The study reports 89 qualified participants and states that the device passed both reported AAMI/ESH/ISO criteria. The reviewed PubMed packet did not establish funding independence. MDRank has not performed hands-on or laboratory testing of this monitor.

ihealth-track-kn-550bt.question: Does the displayed HSA/FSA eligibility change the score?
